inspiration.observed_pattern: A CASE expression selects a scalar ordered GROUP_CONCAT result and exposes the aggregate's result metadata through the enclosing projection.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to two fixed title fragments and one CASE-wrapped correlated scalar GROUP_CONCAT, isolating the MariaDB BLOB metadata from the original JSON, ranking, and update pipeline.

fixture_notes: Two fragments produce one deterministic title; the CASE keeps the scalar aggregate on the selected branch and an empty string on the alternate branch.
determinism_notes: Fragment IDs and ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_title_fragments (fragment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, fragment_text VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE mini_ranked_titles AS SELECT CASE WHEN 1 = 1 THEN (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(fragment_text ORDER BY fragment_id SEPARATOR '') FROM mini_title_fragments) ELSE '' END AS title
